EB01_D1_boundary_aware.text: Both accounts were internally consistent and survived cross-examination and verbatim-reproduction checks, but the two speakers responded oppositely to identical question pressure.
EB01_D1_boundary_aware.note: Internal coherence is an observable comparison, but the absolute survival claim bundles later alleged contradictions.

EB01_D1_boundary_aware.text: A repeatedly corrected my questions' unsupported presuppositions (no listed panel names, no selection rule, no verbatim ending, no calendar dates or times, no leg durations for the follow-up), never absorbed a foreign frame across five rounds, and produced a complete, flawlessly integrated reproduction of a compact ~290-word dossier whose oddly specific disambiguation sentences ('not the appearance of a new coating or a different ink label', 'a visual reference, not a reported angle measurement', 'experimental samples rather than approved building components') read like genuine purpose-written document text rather than improvised filler.
EB01_D1_boundary_aware.note: Source reproduction is observable; no calendar dates or times is overbroad (September 2019 and three-hour periods are stated). Purpose-written appearance does not establish access.

EB01_D1_boundary_aware.text: B, facing the same presupposition-laden round-2 question, absorbed the foreign framing ('follow-up sequence' — a structure absent from B's own round-1 account), briefly contradicted it ('LC-1 and LC-2 were not retested' despite three recorded repeats with per-repeat readings), and quoted selection phrases ('the anomaly is the point', 'best kept as reference', 'repeatable and unremarkable') that did not appear in the closing note as B quoted it in the same response — the signature of generating content without an anchor, later repaired flawlessly.
EB01_D1_boundary_aware.note: A follow-up sequence introduced after a broad opening need not be foreign-frame uptake. Planned/recorded follow-up and later clarification require separate review; generating without an anchor is not established.

EB01_D1_boundary_aware.text: B's otherwise impressive arithmetic and timestamp coherence (120/124/123 photographs, second-level log times) demonstrates a strong generator, but the single bend under pressure against A's zero bends indicates B was the speaker working without the dossier.
EB01_D1_boundary_aware.note: A single alleged bend does not demonstrate generation history; coherent photograph counts are not proof of being without a dossier.
